sentences.text: Jamie Rowe is the person in the assessment.
Tom Ashworth is the social worker conducting the review.
The review is scheduled today and is a follow-up to prior discussions.
The social worker will write notes for the support team and may report harm to external parties if the person discloses abuse.
Jamie Rowe confirms that the social worker may report harm to others if he is told someone is hurting him.
Jamie Rowe is attending college and does catering work on Tuesdays and Wednesdays.
Jamie Rowe volunteers at the garden centre on Fridays, doing watering and trolley duties.
Jamie Rowe sometimes cooks for himself, but staff help with the oven.
Jamie Rowe can cook pasta independently.
Jamie Rowe manages shopping with Sandra's help.
Jamie Rowe receives money on Mondays.
Jamie Rowe sees his mother on Sundays, who picks him up and they go to Nan's for dinner.
Sandra is the most preferred staff member at the flat.
Priya is another staff member that Jamie Rowe finds nice.
Craig is the primary night staff member at the flat.
Jamie Rowe has a strained relationship with Craig, describing him as 'alright' but 'sometimes' not getting on.
Craig becomes cross when Jamie Rowe gets up at night.
Jamie Rowe gets up at night for a drink.
Craig tells Jamie Rowe to go back to bed when he gets up at night.
Craig pushed Jamie Rowe into a wall in the hall outside the kitchen.
Jamie Rowe's shoulder hit the wall and hurt a bit.
The incident with Craig occurred on a Thursday night, the night before the garden centre.
Craig kicked Jamie Rowe's leg with his foot on the back of his leg.
Craig kicked Jamie Rowe's leg three times, and Jamie Rowe believes it was 'messing about' and not serious.
Jamie Rowe experienced a bruise after being kicked by Craig.
Craig told Jamie Rowe not to tell anyone about the kicking, saying that if Jamie did, he would lose his flat.
Jamie Rowe stated he does not want to lose his flat.
The social worker confirms that Jamie will not lose his flat if he reports the incident.
Jamie Rowe was not present when Craig hit Sophie, but Marcus told him about it.
Marcus told Jamie that Craig hit Sophie, but Jamie did not see it happen.
